title: Add pagination to admin order list

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
+from shopapp.config import PAGE_SIZE
+from shopapp.db import fetch_all
+
+
+def list_all_orders(page: int = 1) -> list[dict]:
+    offset = page * PAGE_SIZE
+    return fetch_all("SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?", (PAGE_SIZE, offset))

expected.comment: Off-by-one: pages are 1-based (see orders.list_orders), so page 1 skips the first PAGE_SIZE orders. Use (page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE and validate page >= 1.
